name: Fresh Canna Live Resin Infused Preroll | Strawberry Cough
description:
Powered by premium sativa flower and boosted with terpene-rich live resin, this 1.2G infused pre-roll delivers elevated potency and loud, sweet berry terps. Built for consumers who want a strong head high with bold flavor and heavy smoke output.

Strain: Strawberry Cough (Sativa)

Infusion: Full-spectrum Live Resin

Total Weight: 1.2g

Aroma: Sweet ripe strawberry, light herbal spice, subtle earthy haze

Flavor: Sugary berry inhale with smooth herbal-citrus finish

Effects: Fast-hitting cerebral uplift, mood elevation, energizing buzz

Experience: Thick smoke, slow even burn, intensified terp expression
